caption:
59.2 kilometres north from Nosara brings the expedition to the bay at Tamarindo.

After 2,632 metres of climbing on the Nosara loop, Day 6 runs up the Guanacaste surf coast. The route leaves the turtle refuge at Ostional and passes San Juanillo, Marbella, and Playa Negra, accumulating 782 metres of elevation gain before finishing on the sand.

We sleep for 2 nights at Hotel Capitán Suizo, at the south end of the bay. The hardest climbing of the week is behind us, and the final riding day is a 23.8-kilometre run to Brasilito.

Why this route ends on the coast: because a peninsula traverse should finish where the dirt gives way to salt water, with 356 kilometres behind 6 riders.

Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
